# dispatch-two-builds' fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-dispatch-two-builds.yaml): the Dispatch store's
# connections command its sizing step runs, the modules of the twobuild-tagged tests of
# ./cmd/dispatch, and the Dispatch server its browser half builds (its build step, and
# e2e/run-server.sh). The earlier releases' builds are build-dispatch-build.sh's, which reads each
# release's own module files online.
deps packages/envoy ./internal/dispatch/store/cmd/connections
deps packages/envoy -test -tags twobuild ./cmd/dispatch
deps packages/envoy ./cmd/dispatch
